q: Citizen criticises sarpanch work peacefully online, police threaten arrest, correct?
options: Protect unless defamation or incitement shown
expl: Mere criticism protected; only defined limits allow action.
why: Dislike is no ground. False defamatory charge differs from comment.

q: Group seeks peaceful unarmed meeting, denied without law, correct?
expl: Peaceful unarmed assembly protected; need lawful ground.
why: Inconvenience is insufficient. Order must cite public order basis.

q: Tailor moves towns and opens shop, police order exit, correct?
expl: Move, reside, profess protected; limits need law.
why: No written restriction shown. Discretion cannot expel citizen.

q: Theft accused stays silent to avoid self-harm, correct?
expl: None can be compelled to be witness against self.
why: Questioning allowed, compulsion barred. Voluntary differs from forced.

q: Arrested man held 48 hrs no magistrate citing busy station, correct?
options: Produce in 24 hrs excluding travel; delay illegal
expl: 24-hour production excluding journey mandatory.
why: Busyness is no excuse. Gravity does not extend station hold.

q: Post falsely calls doctor corrupt to ruin practice, action?
options: May attract defamation linked to speech limit
expl: False reputation attack can attract defamation law.
why: Truthful comment differs from false imputation. Like alone no crime.

q: Procession insists on swords claiming absolute assembly, correct?
options: Must be peaceful unarmed; arms allow regulation
expl: Assembly cover needs peaceful unarmed conduct.
why: Weapons remove core condition. Route control can be lawful.

q: New heavier penalty applied to 2022 theft, valid?
options: No, judged by law on date plus no heavier tag
expl: No retro crime nor heavier retro penalty.
why: Date freezes crime and quantum. Later law only forward.

q: Acquitted robber retried criminally same facts same offence, valid?
options: Barred as second prosecution-punishment same offence
expl: Second criminal jeopardy for same offence barred.
why: Appeal differs from fresh jeopardy. Public anger no ground.

q: Woman sought 9 pm no urgency no magistrate nod, SI should?
options: Avoid; need urgency plus prior magistrate nod
expl: Night arrest woman needs need plus prior permission.
why: Routine pickup violates safeguard. Day action or nod required.

q: Beating for confession vs asking voluntary answers?
expl: Compulsion barred; voluntary cooperation allowed.
why: Method matters. Force vitiates statement.

q: Past innocent later criminalised vs past crime heavier penalty?
expl: Both limbs barred: no retro tag nor heavier dose.
why: Act date controls. Later law forward only.

q: Punitive after conviction vs preventive to avert danger?
options: Punitive follows trial; preventive capped with Board and plea
expl: Preventive needs Board beyond 3 months plus plea.
why: Purpose changes check. Trial differs from anticipation.

q: Fair just reasonable vs any written rule?
expl: Post-Maneka test demands fairness.
why: Mere existence insufficient. Arbitrariness fails.

q: Free movement vs settle anywhere?
options: Allied but residence adds tribal-public interest limits
expl: Both protected; residence has extra settlement limits.
why: Travel differs from settlement. Both need lawful limit.

q: S1 Speech limitable for order. S2 Defamation valid limit. S3 Criticism alone equals incitement?
expl: S1 S2 true; mere criticism not incitement.
why: Limits defined. S3 overreads to silence dissent.

q: S1 No retro crime. S2 No heavier retro dose. S3 Same act retried if anger?
expl: First two true; second jeopardy barred.
why: Anger no override. Appeal differs from fresh trial.

q: S1 Know grounds. S2 Counsel allowed. S3 24 hrs includes travel?
expl: S1 S2 true; travel excluded from count.
why: Grounds-counsel core. S3 misstates computation.

q: S1 Life mere animal. S2 Procedure fair just reasonable. S3 Privacy part of dignity?
expl: Life dignified; fairness privacy affirmed.
why: Maneka expanded beyond survival. Privacy intrinsic.

q: S1 Prevention beyond 3 months needs Board. S2 Grounds plus plea given. S3 Life shields suspendable?
expl: S1 S2 true; criminal-life shields never suspendable.
why: 44th specially protects them. S3 revives overruled logic.
